spans.s:
A technical term used by Pāṇini to denote the Potential and
 Benedictive moods or their terminations (the two moods being distinguished
 as विधिलिङ् and आशीर्लिङ्).
To inflect (a noun) according to its gender.
I. €1 P. (लिङ्गति, लिङ्गित) To go, move. ━II. €10 U. (लिङ्गयति-ते)

A mark, sign, token, an emblem, a badge, symbol, distinguishing mark,
 characteristic; यतिपार्थिवलिङ्गधारिणौ

A false or unreal mark, a guise, disguise, a deceptive badge; लिङ्गैर्मुदः
 संवृतविक्रियास्ते
A means of proof, a proof, evidence.

(In logic) The hetu or middle term in a syllogism; particularly
 the assertion of the hetuʼs being found in the पक्ष or minor
 term coupled with the statement of the invariable concomitance between
 this hetu and the major term; it is thus defined:− व्याप्तिपक्षधर्मतावल्लिङ्गम् Tarka K.
The sign of gender or sex.
Sex; गुणाः पूजास्थानं गुणिषु न च लिङ्गं न च वयः
The genital organ of Śiva worshipped in the form of a Phallus.

The image of a god, an idol; धत्तेऽसावात्मनो लिङ्गं मायया विसृजन्
 गुणान्

One of the relations or indications (such as संयोग, वियोग, साहचर्य
 &c.) which serve to fix the meaning of a word in any particular passage;
 e. g. in कुपितो मकरध्वजः the word कुपित restricts the
 meaning of मकरध्वज to ‘Kāma’; see K.

(In Vedānta phil.). The subtle frame or body, the indestructible
 original of the gross or visible body; cf. पञ्चकोष; यं योगिनो योगसमाधिना
 रहो ध्यायन्ति लिङ्गादसुतो मुमुक्षया
The nominal base, the crude form of a noun (प्रातिपदिक).
(In Sāṅ. phil.) Pradhāna or Prakṛti; q. v.

The effect or product (that which is evolved out of a primary cause
 and itself becomes a producer).
= उपाधि; योगेन धृत्युद्यमसत्त्वयुक्तो लिङ्गं व्यपोहेत् कुशलोऽहमाख्यम्

.
.━{@Comp.@}: लिङ्गाग्रम्, लिङ्गानुशासनम्, लिङ्गार्चनम्, लिङ्गार्शस्, लिङ्गाख्यः, लिङ्गदेहः, लिङ्गशरीरम्, लिङ्गघारिन्, लिङ्गनाशः, लिङ्गपरामर्शः, लिङ्गपीठम्, लिङ्गपुराणम्, लिङ्गप्रतिष्ठा, लिङ्गवर्धन, लिङ्गविपर्ययः, लिङ्गवृत्ति, लिङ्गवृत्तिः, लिङ्गवेदी, लिङ्गशास्त्रम्, लिङ्गशोफः, लिङ्गस्थः
+ -अर्चनम् the worship of Śiva as a liṅga.
+ -अर्शस् n. a particular disease of the genital organs.

+ -आख्यः Name of one of the sub-divisions of the production according
 to Sāṅkhya; लिङ्गाख्यो भावाख्यः Sāṅ.
+ -देहः, -शरीरम् the subtle frame or body; see लिङ्ग (13) above.
+ -देहः, -शरीरम् the subtle frame or body; see लिङ्ग (13) above.

loss of vision, a particular
[]
 disease of the eye.

+ -परामर्शः the finding out or consideration of a sign or characteristic
 (in logic); (e. g. that smoke is a sign of fire); as वह्निव्याप्यधूमवानयं
 पर्वतः
+ -पुराणम् N. of one of the 18 Purāṇas.
+ -प्रतिष्ठा the establishment or consecration of a liṅga.
+ -वर्धन a. causing erection of the male organ.
+ -वेदी the base or pedestal of a liṅga.

+ -स्थः a religious student; न श्रोत्रियो न लिङ्गस्थः (साक्षी
 कार्यः)

Wearing the maks or badges of, having the appearance of, disguised
 as, hypocritical, wearing false badges (at the end of comp.); स वर्णिलिङ्गी
 विदितः समाययौ युधिष्ठिरं द्वैतवने वनेचरः
Having a right to wear signs or badges.
One whose outward form corresponds with his inward character.

A religious student, Brāhmaṇa ascetic; अलिङ्गी लिङ्गिवेषेण यो वृत्तिमुपजीवति ।
 स लिङ्गिनां हरत्येनस्तिर्यग्यौनौ च जायते ॥
The Supreme Being (as the sustainer of liṅga).

N. of a Śaiva sect.
.━{@Comp.@}: लिङ्गिवेषः
+ -वेषः the dress of a religious student.
